answer: TR041에는 삼중 결합이 두 개 있습니다. TR041_7과 TR041_10 사이, TR041_8과 TR041_9 사이입니다. 따라서 원자는 TR041_10, TR041_7, TR041_8, TR041_9입니다. 'connected' 테이블에는 결합마다 양방향 행이 있어서, 중복을 없애고 원자를 한 번씩만 나열했습니다.

sql: select sum(f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) from frpm f join schools s using(CDSCode) where s.EdOpsCode='SSS' and s.City='Fremont' and f.`Academic Year`='2014-2015'
answer: 375 students ages 5-17. Two State Special Schools (EdOpsCode 'SSS') are in Fremont: California School for the Blind (40) and California School for the Deaf-Fremont (335). I added them together, since the question asks for one number.

sql: SELECT DISTINCT p.ID, p.SEX FROM Patient p JOIN Laboratory l ON l.ID = p.ID WHERE p.Diagnosis = 'SLE' AND l.HGB > 10 AND l.HGB < 17 ORDER BY p.Birthday ASC LIMIT 1
answer: Patient 4792723, female (F), born 1920-05-09. This is the oldest SLE patient with at least one hemoglobin (HGB) result between 10 and 17. I read "normal hemoglobin" as any lab record in that range. The oldest patient is the one with the earliest birthday.

sql: SELECT 100.0*SUM(c.gender='F')/COUNT(*) FROM client c JOIN district d ON c.district_id=d.district_id WHERE d.A11>10000
answer: 약 49.61%입니다. 평균 급여(A11)가 10000을 넘는 지역에 등록된 고객 중 여성(gender='F')의 비율입니다. 계좌 개설 지역은 고객의 district_id 기준으로 해석했습니다.

sql: select count(distinct p.ID) from Patient p join Laboratory l on l.ID=p.ID where l.IGA>80 and l.IGA<500 and strftime('%Y',p.`First Date`)>='1990'
answer: 140 patients. I counted distinct patients with at least one lab record where IGA is between 80 and 500 (exclusive) and whose First Date year is 1990 or later.

sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN a.element='cl' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL)*100/COUNT(a.atom_id) AS percent FROM atom a JOIN bond b ON a.molecule_id=b.molecule_id WHERE b.bond_type='-'
answer: Chlorine makes up about 2.68% of atoms. I read "single bond molecules" as atoms joined to bonds with bond_type '-' through molecule_id, which is the reading the given formula implies. An atom in a molecule with several single bonds is counted once for each of them.

sql: SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id FROM atom a JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id WHERE SUBSTR(a.atom_id, 7, 2) BETWEEN '21' AND '25' AND m.label = '+'
answer: 이 쿼리는 원자 번호(atom_id의 7~8번째 글자)가 21~25인 원자를 하나 이상 가진 발암성(label='+') 분자의 molecule_id를 중복 없이 반환합니다. 결과는 TR001, TR006, TR019 등으로 시작합니다. 질문에서 어떤 열을 원하는지 정하지 않아, 분자 ID만 반환하는 쪽으로 해석했습니다.

sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT L.ID) FROM Laboratory L WHERE L.SM IN ('negative','0','-','+-') AND L.ID IN (SELECT ID FROM Examination WHERE Thrombosis = 0)
answer: 6 patients. SM is in Laboratory and Thrombosis is in Examination. The data stores normal SM as 'negative' or '0', not '-' or '+-', so I matched all four values. I counted distinct patients. Counting joined rows would give 7.

sql: select (SUM(CASE WHEN l.Date like '1981-11-%' THEN l."T-CHO" END) - SUM(CASE WHEN l.Date like '1981-12-%' THEN l."T-CHO" END)) * 1.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN l.Date like '1981-12-%' THEN l."T-CHO" END) from Patient p join Laboratory l on p.ID=l.ID where p.Birthday='1959-02-18'
answer: 환자(ID 1610433)의 총콜레스테롤은 1981년 11월 211, 12월 199였습니다. 감소율은 (211-199)/199 ≈ 0.0603, 약 6.03%입니다. 제시된 계산식대로 분모는 12월 값을 썼습니다.

sql: SELECT AVG(L.ALB) FROM Patient P JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID WHERE P.SEX = 'F' AND L.PLT > 400 AND P.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
answer: The average ALB is about 3.912. It is taken over 71 lab records for female SLE patients with PLT > 400. I averaged over lab records, not per patient, so a patient with several qualifying tests counts once per test.

sql: SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'A' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) / SUM(amount) FROM loan
answer: 약 18.02%입니다. 전체 대출 금액 중 status = 'A'(계약 종료, 문제 없음)인 대출 금액의 비율이며, loan 테이블 전체를 기준으로 계산했습니다.

sql: SELECT printf('%.5f', 100.0*SUM(bond_type='=')/COUNT(bond_id)) AS percent FROM bond WHERE molecule_id='TR008';
answer: 분자 TR008에서 이중 결합(bond_type = '=')의 비율은 3.84615%입니다. 전체 결합 수(bond_id 기준) 대비 이중 결합 수를 백분율로 계산했고, 소수점 다섯 자리까지 표시했습니다.

sql: SELECT t.trans_id FROM trans t JOIN disp d ON d.account_id = t.account_id WHERE d.client_id = 3356 AND t.operation = 'VYBER'
answer: client 3356의 계좌(2779)에서 operation='VYBER'(현금 인출)인 거래는 140건입니다. 질문이 어떤 열을 원하는지 명시하지 않아 거래 식별자인 trans_id만 반환했습니다. 날짜나 금액이 필요하면 열을 추가해야 합니다.

sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM atom WHERE molecule_id IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM bond WHERE bond_type='#') AND molecule_id IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM atom WHERE element IN ('p','br'))
answer: The query returns 4. I read the question as: count every atom in molecules that have a triple bond and also contain phosphorus or bromine. The other reading counts only the phosphorus and bromine atoms in triple-bond molecules, and that gives 1.

sql: SELECT m.label FROM atom a JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id WHERE a.element = 'h' GROUP BY m.label ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1
answer: The most numerous label is '-'. It covers 2,465 hydrogen atoms, against 1,569 for '+'. I counted hydrogen atoms (element = 'h') per molecule label, not distinct molecules.

sql: select distinct d.type from disp d join account a on a.account_id=d.account_id join district s on s.district_id=a.district_id where d.type<>'OWNER' and s.A11>8000 and s.A11<=9000
answer: DISPONENT is the only account type that is not eligible for loans and sits in a district with average salary (A11) above 8000 and at most 9000. I read "account type" as disp.type, and only 'OWNER' is eligible.

sql: select max(f.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)`*1.0/f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) from satscores s join frpm f on f.CDSCode=s.cds where s.NumTstTakr>0 and s.NumGE1500*1.0/s.NumTstTakr>0.3 and f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`>0
answer: The highest eligible free rate for ages 5-17 among schools with an SAT excellence rate above 0.3 is about 0.9049. I joined satscores to frpm on the CDS code. I computed the rates from the counts as the question defines them, and skipped schools with zero test takers or zero enrollment.

sql: select l.account_id from loan l join account a using(account_id) where l.date like '1997%' and a.frequency='POPLATEK TYDNE' and l.amount=(select min(l2.amount) from loan l2 join account a2 using(account_id) where l2.date like '1997%' and a2.frequency='POPLATEK TYDNE')
answer: Account 176 (loan amount 27,456, approved 1997-04-10). I read the question as the lowest amount among 1997 loans on accounts with weekly issuance statements (POPLATEK TYDNE), not the lowest among all 1997 loans.

sql: SELECT d.A2, COUNT(c.client_id) AS female_count FROM client c JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id WHERE c.gender = 'F' GROUP BY d.district_id, d.A2 ORDER BY female_count DESC LIMIT 9
answer: 상위 9개 district(A2)와 여성 수는 Hl.m. Praha 324, Karvina 88, Ostrava - mesto 84, Brno - mesto 75, Zlin 57, Olomouc 50, Frydek - Mistek 42, Kolin 39, Nachod 37입니다. "account holders"는 client 테이블에서 gender='F'인 고객으로 해석해 district별로 셌습니다. OWNER 계좌 소유자만 세면 Praha 267, Karvina 74처럼 수치가 작아지지만, 순위는 같습니다.

sql: select s.School, f.`FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)`*100.0/f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` as pct from schools s join frpm f using(CDSCode) where s.County='Los Angeles' and s.GSserved='K-9'
answer: I read "grade span served" as schools.GSserved = 'K-9'. In Los Angeles county, two schools match. White Oak Elementary has 3.76% eligible for FRPM (ages 5-17). The Accelerated has 97.64%. The frpm table's Low Grade/High Grade columns return no K–9 schools in that county, so I didn't use them.

sql: SELECT p.ID, CAST(strftime('%Y','now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER) AS age FROM Patient p JOIN Laboratory l ON l.ID = p.ID WHERE l.HCT >= 52 GROUP BY p.ID HAVING COUNT(*) > 2
answer: Two patients match: ID 2307640 (age 73) and ID 4007151 (age 58). Age is the current year minus the birth year. I used the external knowledge's rule of COUNT > 2, meaning three or more exams with HCT >= 52. If "two or more" is meant literally (>= 2), patient 3182521 (age 74, 2 exams) would also be included.

sql: SELECT DISTINCT element FROM atom WHERE molecule_id = 'TR000' ORDER BY element LIMIT 3
answer: TR000의 원소 중 알파벳순 상위 3개는 c, cl, h입니다. "top three"를 중복 없는 원소 중 알파벳순으로 앞선 3개로 해석했습니다.

sql: select count(distinct p.ID) from Patient p join Laboratory l on p.ID=l.ID join Examination e on e.ID=p.ID where l.SC170 in ('negative','0') and p.SEX='F' and e.Symptoms is null
answer: 2 patients. I counted distinct patients who are female, have SC170 of 'negative' or '0' in Laboratory, and have a NULL Symptoms value in Examination. A patient counts if any of their records meets each condition.

sql: select count(distinct p.ID) from Patient p join Examination e on e.ID=p.ID where strftime('%Y',e.`Examination Date`) between '1990' and '1993' and cast(strftime('%Y',e.`Examination Date`) as int)-cast(strftime('%Y',p.Birthday) as int)<18
answer: 1 patient. I read "underage" as under 18 at the time of the exam (exam year minus birth year < 18), counting distinct patients examined in 1990–1993. The literal hint, year(Birthday) < 18, matches 0 patients because birth years are around 1900–2000.

sql: SELECT c.AdmFName1, c.AdmLName1, c.AdmFName2, c.AdmLName2, c.AdmFName3, c.AdmLName3 FROM satscores s JOIN schools c ON c.CDSCode = s.cds WHERE s.NumGE1500 = (SELECT MAX(NumGE1500) FROM satscores)
answer: The school with the most students scoring 1500 or more (5,837) is administered by Michelle King. It has only one administrator listed; administrators 2 and 3 are empty. I returned the three first-name/last-name pairs, and only the first pair has values.

sql: SELECT d.A2 FROM trans t JOIN account a ON t.account_id=a.account_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id=d.district_id WHERE t.type='VYDAJ' AND t.date LIKE '1996-01%' ORDER BY t.amount DESC LIMIT 10
answer: I read "top ten withdrawals" as the ten largest individual non-credit-card withdrawals (type = 'VYDAJ') in January 1996, ranked by amount. The query returns the district name (A2) for each. Zlin appears three times because three of the ten largest withdrawals came from accounts in that district. The ten districts, largest first: Trutnov, Pelhrimov, Zlin, Olomouc, Frydek - Mistek, Breclav, Karvina, Zlin, Zlin, Jihlava.
